verses.en: Ya Sin

verses.ar: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَكِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: By the Qur'an, full of Wisdom

verses.ar: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Thou art indeed one of the messengers

verses.ar: عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍؕ‏
verses.en: On a Straight Way

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الرَّحِيۡمِۙ‏
verses.en: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful

verses.ar: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّا٘ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of Allah)

verses.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰ٘ي اَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe

verses.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ اَغۡلٰلًا فَهِيَ اِلَي الۡاَذۡقَانِ فَهُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ
verses.en: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see)

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see

verses.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَهُمۡؕؔ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ فِيۡ٘ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence)

verses.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡيَةِۘ اِذۡ جَآءَهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it

verses.ar: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمُ اثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاۙ وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۙ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا تَكۡذِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ اِنَّا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَا٘ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
verses.en: And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا طَآئِرُكُمۡ مَّعَكُمۡؕ اَئِنۡ ذُكِّرۡتُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسۡعٰيؗ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوا الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers

verses.ar: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance

verses.ar: وَمَا لِيَ لَا٘ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back

verses.ar: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةً اِنۡ يُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّيۡ شَفَاعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يُنۡقِذُوۡنِۚ‏
verses.en: Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اِذًا لَّفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِؕ‏
verses.en: For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me

verses.ar: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَنَّةَؕ قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِيۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)

verses.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِيۡ رَبِّيۡ وَجَعَلَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ
verses.en: For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do

verses.ar: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent

verses.ar: يٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَي الۡعِبَادِۚ࣠ مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
verses.en: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment)

verses.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَيۡتَةُۚۖ اَحۡيَيۡنٰهَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡهُ يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.en: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat

verses.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡعُيُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein

verses.ar: لِيَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِهٖۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks

verses.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۭۡ بِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge

verses.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيۡلُۚۖ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness

verses.ar: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِيۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّهَاؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِؕ‏
verses.en: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing

verses.ar: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰي عَادَ كَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِيۡمِ
verses.en: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk

verses.ar: لَا الشَّمۡسُ يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهَا٘ اَنۡ تُدۡرِكَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law)

verses.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۙ‏
verses.en: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark

verses.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ مَا يَرۡكَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيۡخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡقَذُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered

verses.ar: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
verses.en: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back)

verses.ar: وَمَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
verses.en: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom

verses.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطۡعَمَهٗ٘ࣗۖ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error

verses.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true

verses.ar: مَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves

verses.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِيَةً وَّلَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people

verses.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَنۡسِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۭۡ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَاۘࣝ࣠ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers

verses.ar: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us

verses.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds

verses.ar: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِ الۡيَوۡمَ فِيۡ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do

verses.ar: هُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُهُمۡ فِيۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity)

verses.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمۡ مَّا يَدَّعُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for

verses.ar: سَلٰمٌࣞ قَوۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَامۡتَازُوا الۡيَوۡمَ اَيُّهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ اَعۡهَدۡ اِلَيۡكُمۡ يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوا الشَّيۡطٰنَۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed

verses.ar: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِيۡؕؔ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡكُمۡ جِبِلًّا كَثِيۡرًاؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand

verses.ar: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned

verses.ar: اِصۡلَوۡهَا الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)

verses.ar: اَلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰ٘ي اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا٘ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ اَرۡجُلُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰي يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰي مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error)

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي الۡخَلۡقِؕ اَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهٗؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear

verses.ar: لِّيُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡنَا٘ اَنۡعَامًا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مٰلِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion

verses.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوۡبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat

verses.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful

verses.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned)

verses.ar: فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ اِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهٗؕ قَالَ مَنۡ يُّحۡيِ الۡعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيۡمٌ
verses.en: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)

verses.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيۡهَا الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَهَا٘ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation

verses.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)

verses.ar: اَوَلَيۡسَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡؕؔ بَلٰيࣗ وَهُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)

verses.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اَمۡرُهٗ٘ اِذَا٘ اَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
verses.en: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is

verses.ar: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back
